rules.text: A paid plan is refundable within 14 calendar days of purchase if no paid features have been used.
A paid plan with any paid-feature usage is not eligible for a standard refund.
A purchase more than 14 calendar days ago is not eligible for a standard refund.
A duplicate charge is eligible for correction regardless of purchase age or feature usage.
When purchase age or paid-feature usage is unknown, do not promise a standard refund. Ask for the missing fact.
